title: Fibrewise local-complete-intersection source locus for a flat lfp algebraic space
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let $f:X\to S$ be a flat locally finitely presented morphism of algebraic spaces [def-trf-algebraic-space], in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. Flatness and local finite presentation are tested on etale scheme charts using [def-weil-flat-morphism, def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation]. Fibre products are those of [lem-trf-space-fibre-products-etale-covers]. Open subspaces and underlying point topologies are [def-a1-space-open-subspace, def-a1-space-point-topology]. Over a field $k$, a scheme is a local complete intersection if it has an affine open cover by spectra of finitely generated local-complete-intersection $k$-algebras [def-weil-pbc-complete-intersection-over-field]; for an algebraic space this is tested on etale scheme charts. There is a largest open subspace $U_f\subseteq X$ such that every fibre of $U_f\to S$ is a local complete intersection over its residue base field. For each representable etale scheme chart $a:V\to X$, the inverse image of $U_f$ in $V$ is the fibrewise complete-intersection locus $V_{f\circ a}$ of [lem-trf-syntomic-locus-base-change]. For every scheme morphism $g:T\to S$, the base change $f_T:X_T=X\times_ST\to T$ is flat and locally of finite presentation, and $U_{f_T}=U_f\times_ST$ as open subspaces of $X_T$. In particular, $U_f=X$ if and only if every fibre of $f$ is a local complete intersection. Neither closedness nor properness of $f$ is assumed; the empty source and empty fibres are allowed.

proof.text: Choose a representable surjective etale scheme atlas $p:P\to X$ using [def-trf-algebraic-space]. Since flatness and local finite presentation are tested on etale charts, $h=f p:P\to S$ is flat and locally of finite presentation; this is the $V=S$ case of [lem-sfb-space-local-properties-chart-test]. Apply [lem-trf-syntomic-locus-base-change] to $h$ and write $L=V_h\subseteq P$ for its open fibrewise complete-intersection locus. Its points are exactly those $u$ at which the local ring of $P_{h(u)}$ is a complete intersection. No finite-presentation hypothesis on the whole atlas is needed.

Put $R=P\times_XP$ and let $s,t:R\to P$ be its projections. These are etale scheme maps by representability and base change [def-trf-algebraic-space, lem-trf-space-fibre-products-etale-covers]. For $r\in R$ let $b=f p s(r)=f p t(r)$. Base changing to $\kappa(b)$ gives etale maps $R_b\to P_b$. Apply [lem-sfb-lci-etale-pointwise-invariance] to these maps at $r$: the complete-intersection condition at $s(r)$ is equivalent to that at $r$, and to that at $t(r)$. The pointwise description in [lem-trf-syntomic-locus-base-change] therefore gives $s^{-1}(L)=t^{-1}(L)$ as open subschemes of $R$. Equality here is equality of open subsets equipped with their restricted structure sheaves.

source.place: Tag 06CA, chartwise description of the Koszul locus; descent.tex Tag 036S.

proof.text: Apply [lem-trf-etale-open-chart-morphism-descent] with atlas $p$, invariant open $L$, target $S$ and $q=h|_L$. The required equality on the restricted relation follows from $p s=p t$. It gives an open subspace $U_f\subseteq X$ with $P\times_XU_f=L$. Now take any representable etale chart $a:V\to X$. The scheme $W=V\times_XP$ has etale projections to $V$ and $P$, with $W\to V$ surjective [lem-trf-space-fibre-products-etale-covers]. Apply [lem-sfb-lci-etale-pointwise-invariance] on each residue-base fibre of these two projections. The pointwise descriptions of [lem-trf-syntomic-locus-base-change] show that the pullbacks to $W$ of $V_{f a}$ and $L$ agree. The scheme-test uniqueness clause of [lem-trf-etale-open-chart-morphism-descent] now identifies $V\times_XU_f$ with $V_{f a}$.

source.place: Tag 06CA and spaces-properties.tex Tag 03BZ (lemma-open-subspaces), invariant atlas open; spaces.tex Tag 02WU.

proof.text: For every $b\in S$ and every etale chart $V\to X$, the points of $(V\times_XU_f)_b$ have complete-intersection local rings by the preceding chart formula and [lem-trf-syntomic-locus-base-change]. By [lem-trf-lci-pointwise-criterion], this fibre has an affine cover by spectra of finitely generated local-complete-intersection $\kappa(b)$-algebras. These base-changed charts cover $(U_f)_b$ [lem-trf-space-fibre-products-etale-covers], so the chartwise definition in the statement says precisely that $(U_f)_b$ is a local complete intersection. Conversely, let $A\subseteq X$ be any source open whose fibres are local complete intersections. Its pullback to $P$ has fibrewise complete-intersection local rings by the same criterion, and hence its point image is contained in $L$. Thus $|A|\subseteq|U_f|$, since $P\to X$ is surjective. The inclusion criterion of [lem-a1-space-point-open-calculus] gives $A\subseteq U_f$. This proves maximality. The chartwise condition does not depend on the charts: if $E\to Y$ is a surjective family of etale scheme charts of an algebraic space $Y$ over $\kappa(b)$, such as $(U_f)_b$ or $A_b$, and $E'\to Y$ is any etale scheme chart, then $E\times_YE'$ is a scheme with etale projections, the one to $E'$ surjective [lem-trf-space-fibre-products-etale-covers], so [lem-sfb-lci-etale-pointwise-invariance] transfers complete-intersection local rings from $E$ to every point of $E'$; with [lem-trf-lci-pointwise-criterion] it holds on one surjective family iff on every chart.

source.place: Tag 06C9 (lemma-flat-lci); morphisms.tex Tags 01UF and 01UG; spaces-properties.tex Tag 03BZ.

proof.text: Let $g:T\to S$ be arbitrary. The pullback $P_T=P\times_ST\to X_T$ is a surjective etale scheme atlas [lem-trf-space-fibre-products-etale-covers]. The scheme map $h_T:P_T\to T$ is flat by [lem-weil-pbc-flat-morphism-base-change] and locally of finite presentation by [lem-weil-pbc-qcqs-morphism-permanence], clause (3). The atlas criterion [lem-sfb-space-local-properties-chart-test] gives these properties for $f_T$. By [lem-trf-syntomic-locus-base-change], $V_{h_T}=L\times_ST$. Applying the construction above to $f_T$ therefore gives an open $U_{f_T}$ whose pullback to $P_T$ is $L\times_ST$. The open $U_f\times_ST$ has exactly the same pullback, by associativity of the sheaf fibre product. The uniqueness clause of [lem-trf-etale-open-chart-morphism-descent] identifies these two open subspaces of $X_T$.

source.place: Tag 06CA, final base-change argument via pulled-back atlases; morphisms.tex Tag 02V3.

proof.text: If $U_f=X$, its fibre property already proved is the required property for every fibre of $f$. Conversely, if every fibre of $f$ is a local complete intersection, $X$ itself is one of the source opens to which maximality applies, so $X\subseteq U_f$. Thus $U_f=X$. When $X$ is empty the atlas and the locus are empty, and every step gives the unique empty open; empty fibres impose no conditions. None of the construction, comparison or maximality steps uses closedness or properness.

lean.statement: theorem exists_fibrewiseLci_open_baseChange {B : Scheme.{u}} (X : AlgebraicSpace B) (T : Over B) (f : X.obj.obj ⟶ yoneda.obj T) (hflat : MapToSchemeIsLocally (@Flat) X T f) (hfp : MapToSchemeIsLocally (@LocallyOfFinitePresentation) X T f) : ∃ A : OpenSubspace X, HasCompleteIntersectionFibresToScheme T (A.val.ι ≫ f) ∧ (∀ C : OpenSubspace X, HasCompleteIntersectionFibresToScheme T (C.val.ι ≫ f) → C ≤ A) ∧ (∀ (V : Over B) (a : yoneda.obj V ⟶ X.obj.obj), IsEtale a → schemePointMap a ⁻¹' pointImage A.val.ι = (yoneda.preimage (a ≫ f)).left.fiberCompleteIntersectionLocus) ∧ (∀ (T' : Over B) (g : T' ⟶ T), (∀ (V : Over B) (a : yoneda.obj V ⟶ Limits.pullback f (yoneda.map g)), IsEtale a → Flat (yoneda.preimage (a ≫ Limits.pullback.snd f (yoneda.map g))).left ∧ LocallyOfFinitePresentation (yoneda.preimage (a ≫ Limits.pullback.snd f (yoneda.map g))).left) ∧ IsRepresentableWith (fun _ _ p ↦ IsOpenImmersion p.left) (A.val.preimage (Limits.pullback.fst f (yoneda.map g))).ι ∧ HasCompleteIntersectionFibresToScheme T' ((A.val.preimage (Limits.pullback.fst f (yoneda.map g))).ι ≫ Limits.pullback.snd f (yoneda.map g)) ∧ (∀ C : Subfunctor (Limits.pullback f (yoneda.map g)), IsRepresentableWith (fun _ _ p ↦ IsOpenImmersion p.left) C.ι → HasCompleteIntersectionFibresToScheme T' (C.ι ≫ Limits.pullback.snd f (yoneda.map g)) → C ≤ A.val.preimage (Limits.pullback.fst f (yoneda.map g)))) ∧ (A.val = ⊤ ↔ HasCompleteIntersectionFibresToScheme T f)
